query: A game VFX sprite sheet: exactly 8 animation frames arranged in a strict grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, read left to right, top row first. Every cell is exactly the same size with the coin centered in its cell. One shiny gold Chinese lucky coin with a square hole in the middle and embossed rim, spinning around its vertical axis: frame 1 facing front (full circle), then progressively turning to edge-on (thin vertical ellipse) around frame 3, back to full face at frame 5, edge-on again at frame 7, returning toward front at frame 8. Bright polished gold with strong specular highlights, the same size and lighting in every frame. Pure solid black background (#000000), no grid lines, no borders, no numbers, no text, nothing except the coins.
